{{Otheruses|Icefang}}
'''Project Icefang''' was a highly secretive operation carried out by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] to supply and equip the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] with military vehicles and assault ships. The project was placed in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], and was completed by the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
